comparison.objective: Feed a drain rod through a blocked pipe without kinking it, not commission an axis shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Progressive flexible-rod feeding, axial force control, regrasping, and kink avoidance versus rigid hex-key insertion, collar tuning, counterholding, and tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Blockage rodded out without kinking the rod; body is empty and no spec versions or insertion-depth/force rubric are available. Candidate requires repeated carriage-stop performance.
comparison.reason: Flexible-body navigation and blockage clearing test different physics and manipulation abilities.
